strategies.name: higher_timeframe_trend_resumption_after_lower_timeframe_reversal
strategies.entry_summary: Align with a bullish higher timeframe (4H/1H), then on the 15-minute or 5-minute chart wait for the corrective downtrend to stop making lower lows and break above the most recent lower high. Enter on that break back bullish, with the speaker also showing the same structure as an ABC-style reversal/3
strategies.exit_summary: Place the stop loss under the recent low/level that should not break if the reversal is valid. Target the next higher-timeframe high (such as the 1-hour high), with the option to keep holding if the broader trend continues.

variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: wait for price to stop making lower lows and then break above the lower high
variants.target_note: target the 1-hour high or continue with the higher-timeframe trend
variants.transcript_quote: all you're doing is waiting for price to go back bullish on that 15minut time frame and putting your stop loss under that level

variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: same ABC / higher-low then break-above-lower-high structure
variants.target_note: speaker describes this as potentially reaching the 1-hour high and even larger trend continuation
